parinshahaibuilder-ipo-offer-document-re.description: Forensic regulatory and investor review of Indian IPO offer documents against SEBI ICDR 2018, SEBI LODR, the Companies Act 2013, Schedule III, Ind AS and tax law. Finds internal inconsistencies (the same figure carrying two values in two places), arithmetic that does not foot, unexplained material movements, missing mandatory disclosures, earnings quality issues and pricing sections that do not support themselves. Produces a severity graded report citing findings to paragraph level, plus an issuer letter on request. Use whenever the user supplies a DRHP, RHP or red herring prospectus and asks…
